x: F.A.Bool was Hon.Secretary of the Club from 1898 to 1903 and was made a Life-Member in 1905. He lived in Chelsea all his life and his daughter tells us that he followed the fortunes of Belgrave until the end.
Bob Taylor, President for the past year and the next hour, opened the proceedings and the members present stood in memory of T.Ball and F.Bool who had passed away during the year.
Three only of the seven shown can be identified, A.G. BOOL (2nd left), F.A.
He was succeeded by FRANK BOOL who held office for five years, and it will be remembered that he died only a year or two ago at his home in Chelsea, aged 93 years.
